messages:
maya: Hey folks — PR #20102 is failing CI on integration shard 4 with `db-conn-timeout`. Fails on Buildkite fairly frequently but I can't repro locally. Link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/integ/builds/4567 (shard 4). Anyone seen this recently? cc @anil @ash

anil: Thanks for the ping. Can you paste the failing stack trace/logs here? Also which infra image this ran on? :eyes:

maya: Sure — here's the tail from the failing job:```
ERROR: ConnectionError: failed to connect to postgres: dial tcp 172.17.0.3:5432: i/o timeout
  at DBClient._connect (/app/services/db-client.js:78:15)
  at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)
  at async runInteg (/app/test/integration/run.js:42:9)
```
Ran on `ci-image:v2026-03-10` (that's what the build metadata shows).

ash: That looks like the ephemeral Postgres container isn't ready before tests start. We've had flaky starts when the node is under load. Two quick checks: 1) are we using the readiness wait in the test harness? 2) can you try a targeted rerun of shard 4 (Buildkite has a rerun button) to see if it passes on retry?

maya: I did a targeted rerun just now. Triggered it, job 4567.2 started — will post results in a min.

ci-bot: buildkite: Job 4567.2 (PR #20102, shard 4) started by @maya — https://buildkite.com/redwood/integ/builds/4567.2

sam: Hold merge until we confirm it's not a regression. If rerun flaps, we can try increasing the DB readiness timeout or add a retry in the test setup.

lee: I skimmed the PR — small NIT but LGTM once we stabilize CI. If we add a retry, prefer a short exponential backoff (100ms -> 200ms -> 400ms) and a max wait of ~5s to avoid hiding real connection issues.

maya: Rerun passed: ci-bot reports 4567.2 ✅. But I agree — this is flaky. I'll open a follow-up tweak in the test harness to add retry+backoff and also add an env knob for readiness timeout. Pushing a tiny change now.

ci-bot: buildkite: Job 4567.2 finished — PASSED (triggered by @maya) — https://buildkite.com/redwood/integ/builds/4567.2

anil: Thanks. If you can prepare the follow-up as a small PR and add a comment in #eng-ci about the change, we can merge #20102 after a clean rerun.

maya: Will do. I'll create PR #20115 for the harness tweaks and link it here when ready. Removing merge hold after one more green run. :thumbsup:

sam: Sounds good. Thanks for handling the follow-up, @maya :clap:

lee: Once #20115 is up, can you also add a short test note in the PR template about flaky DB containers so we have a trail?

maya: Yep — adding that to the PR description. ETA for #20115 in ~20m.

ci-bot: buildkite: Job 4567.3 (PR #20102, full run) started by @maya — https://buildkite.com/redwood/integ/builds/4567.3

ci-bot: buildkite: Job 4567.3 finished — PASSED (triggered by @maya) — https://buildkite.com/redwood/integ/builds/4567.3

maya: All green now. Merging shortly after I push the harness PR and get one more quick approval on that. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
